relations.text: 傘下Express Scriptsが薬剤給付管理を複数年で受託(2024年1月から)
relations.text_en: Its Express Scripts unit manages Centene's pharmacy benefits under a multi-year deal from January 2024

source.label: Cigna 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Express Scripts and Centene Corporation ("Centene") have a multi-year agreement, which began January 1, 2024, to manage pharmacy benefit services

relations.text: NIA買収などを通じてCenteneとの提携が拡大
relations.text_en: Its partnership with Centene grew through the NIA acquisition and other work

source.label: Evolent Health 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In addition, our partnership with Centene has grown, both as a result of the NIA acquisition and from other partnership opportunities.

relations.text: 主要な保険会社パートナーの一社(売上の7.6%、2025年)
relations.text_en: A main health plan partner (7.6% of revenue in 2025)

source.label: GoHealth 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the primary health plan partners that we served were United, Humana, Elevance, Aetna and Centene.

companies.name: P3ヘルス・パートナーズ

relations.text: 主要な支払者(保険会社)の一社としてCenteneを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Centene among its key payors

source.label: P3 Health Partners 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: in particular with key payors such as Centene Corporation, Atrio Health Plans, United Healthcare and Aetna

relations.text: Centene傘下の事業を買う契約にCenteneも当事者として参加(2024年7月)
relations.text_en: Bought businesses under an agreement to which Centene was also a party (July 2024)

source.label: Astrana Health 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: and solely with respect to certain sections of the Purchase Agreement, Centene Corporation

relations.text: 反トラスト訴訟でCenteneなどに4000万ドルを払う和解(2024年11月)
relations.text_en: Settled antitrust claims with Centene and Humana for $40 million (November 2024)

source.label: Indivior 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Under the agreement, Indivior Inc. and Indivior Solutions Inc. will pay a total of $ 40 million to the Humana and Centene companies.

companies.name: モリナ・ヘルスケア
companies.sub: 医療保険(メディケイド)

relations.text: Molinaが10-Kで、メディケイドとマーケットプレイスの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Molina names Centene its primary low-income Marketplace competitor

source.label: Molina Healthcare 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitor for low-income Marketplace membership is Centene Corporation.

relations.text: Cloverが10-Kで、メディケア・アドバンテージの大手競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Clover names Centene among large Medicare Advantage competitors

source.label: Clover Health 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors generally include large, national insurers, such as United Health, Aetna, Humana, Centene, and Elevance Health
